_comment: Women writers acquisition wave 1 (#7908). Christine de Pizan complete first, then women across the library's traditions.
PRODUCED BY: IA advancedsearch (date <= 1928, lending-only items dropped) over a ~150-author want list, three rounds (2026-11-01);
the JHU Christine de Pizan Digital Scriptorium IIIF collection (54 BnF MSS) mapped to works with its own works table;
hand subject-filter and imprint screen (import-workflow.md 3 and 3b); then checkHoldings() on every pick (title+author+year+URL).
SELECTION: earliest edition / original language wins; one good witness per work; we keep an earlier edition when we hold only a later one.
IMPORTED WITH: scripts/import/new-world-wave.mjs (ia) and scripts/import/iiif-direct-import.mjs (jhu, manifests read from local copies
because jdm.library.jhu.edu's TLS certificate has expired; image.library.jhu.edu is fine but refuses /full/full/, hence iiif_size=max).
Both with --sweep women-wave-7908: the wave tag is a sweep_log row per book, not a field. All books land hidden (visible:false + hidden:true).
verdict: import | held (held_link) | skip — see `skips` for blocked sources and screened-out items; `wave2` is the remainder.
